title: The uproar over how 'Fortnite' is being released for Android shows how much we have acquiesced to Apple's way of doing business (AAPL, GOOGL)
text: The uproar over how 'Fortnite' is being released for Android shows how much we have acquiesced to Apple's way of doing business (AAPL, GOOGL) By Troy Wolverton Aug 4, 2018, 11:18 am 41 pts Epic Games announced Friday that it won't distribute the upcoming Android version of its "Fortnite: Battle Royale" game through Google's Play Store.
